prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A Before Times relic held in an Aurora Stack deepest vault — an
impossible shard of uncertain material whose surface shifts between
states, edges impossibly sharp. Serial numbers ("8H-H1Y0B") are incised
into its face in faintly phosphorescent script in a language no one alive
can read. Resting on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal. Aurora-crystal
shards arranged in a warding pattern around the pedestal. A cold
wrongness halo around the relic — the ice-memory itself recoils.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, game-poster saturation, single artifact centered on a square field with clean silhouette separation. An impossible relic shard rests on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal — the shard's surface shifts between states, glassy one moment, metallic the next, edges geometrically sharp beyond natural fracture. The serial number "8H-H1Y0B" is incised across its face in faintly phosphorescent script, cool aurora-green glow (#2DB56B) bleeding from each stroke. Aurora-crystal shards arranged in a precise warding ring around the pedestal base catch prismatic light, scattering thin spectral ribbons. The volcanic-glass pedestal is deep obsidian-black with carved ceremonial linework. A cold distortion halo surrounds the relic — surrounding ice rendered in pale shelf-blue (#4A90C5) pulling subtly away, recoiling. Deep slate shadow grounds the composition. Lighting is cool, diffuse, sourceless — the relic itself the only warm-edged glow.
